summary: Iteration 11 backend testing for GST (5%) + weight-based per-unit shipping. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11_gst_weight_shipping.py with 25 tests — ALL PASSED. Covered POST /api/shipping/calculate for all four zones (chennai/tn/south_india/others) across 500 ml & 1000 ml variants, per-unit multiplication (2x500ml=200 south), mixed cart (1x1000ml+1x500ml=400 others), unlisted/zero-rated variants (200ml, 5 Litre -> 0), freeShippingAbove (subtotal 999 & 1500 -> FREE_SHIPPING rule regardless of items/zone), invalid pincode -> 400, unserviceable pincode -> 422 via admin PUT + auto-restore. Verified POST /api/orders authoritative server-side recompute: subtotal 555 -> gst 27.75, chennai 500ml -> shipping 45, total 627.75; deliberately wrong client shipping=0/total=1 still returns server-correct 27.75/45/627.75; free-shipping order (subtotal 1000 to Delhi) -> gst 50, shipping 0, total 1050. Verified admin invoice.pdf endpoint returns 200 + application/pdf + %PDF magic (raw bytes are FlateDecode+ASCII85 compressed so 'GST' literal isn't grep-able but is present per admin_pdf.py source). Admin shipping GET/PUT round-trip preserves weightRates + southIndiaStates; /download returns JSON; PUT missing rules -> 400. Full regression suite: 183 passed / 5 skipped.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _compute_shipping: freeShippingAbove uses `subtotal >= float(free_above)` — inclusive threshold, matches spec (999). Good.
server.py create_order: correctly ignores client-supplied shipping/total and rebuilds via _compute_shipping — this is the correct server-side authority pattern.

admin_shipping.put_rates only validates defaultCharge + rules; the new weightRates / southIndiaStates / freeShippingAbove are NOT validated. A malformed PUT (e.g. weightRates as list, or south_india zone missing) will silently persist and could break /shipping/calculate. Consider validating weightRates is a dict of {variant: {chennai, tn, south_india, others}} numbers and southIndiaStates is a list[str].
server.py Order model has paymentStatus='PAID' unconditionally for COD — pre-existing, flagged in iteration 10, still not addressed.

shipping_rates.json still carries legacy `rules` + `defaultCharge` — these are dead once weight-based shipping is authoritative. Consider removing to reduce config drift (or the validator in admin_shipping should stop requiring them).
Products list in preview appears admin-edited (subtotal 555 does not correspond to any current SKU) — tests correctly assert on math rather than product prices.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration11 tests are self-contained. Run serial with `-n 0` to be safe with shared config. To assert the literal 'GST' string inside the PDF you would need pypdf / pdfminer to decompress the FlateDecode/ASCII85 stream — omitted here because the task spec says 200 + application/pdf is sufficient. Follow-up validation for admin_shipping PUT to reject malformed weightRates would be a good next iteration.
rca of the issue: No production bug found. Initial iteration11 run had one test failure (assert b'GST' in raw PDF bytes) — root cause was that the PDF stream is compressed with FlateDecode+ASCII85, so the literal 'GST' text is not present in the untouched bytes. Fixed the test to only assert 200 + application/pdf + %PDF magic, matching the spec.
